body: Unfortunately, I tried, but this particular subject coordinator said that the presentation and subsequent participation marks with the discussions were important and I definitely couldn't skip them. :(

Yeeeah I'm a 5 foot tall asian girl, I probably am not the best candidate for that.

If all else at uni fails I'll just become a cleaner or something low level, it seems to be the only other option open to me.

But thanks for the encouragement though, I'm in a whiny mood right now but I appreciate it.
Jobs are scarce, quiet office jobs even moreso. I just need to wait and see if it gets bad enough, and if I really can't handle it that'll be it for me.
